user.title: HA Wecker – what do you want to add?

wecker.title: Set up alarm clock
wecker.description: The app reports its alarm list via webhook – it runs no background service and nothing polls it. The webhook address is generated now and shown afterwards in the diagnostic sensor "Webhook" and under "Configure"; that is the address for the app.

saeule.title: Set up signal tower
saeule.description: Address of the signal tower on the network, e.g. 192.168.1.70. The tower shows the last part of its address on the LED matrix at start-up and serves its own dashboard there.

garage.title: Set up garage
garage.description: Address of the garage ESP on the network, e.g. van206-ls.local or 192.168.1.110. Usually not needed: the ESP registers itself as soon as it reaches Home Assistant and keeps its address up to date.

garage.title: Garage
garage.description:
Currently: {url}

The garage ESP reads the light barrier (is the 206 far enough in?), switches the red lamp and listens to the ESP in the car. The traffic light is what the dashboard in the car shows: stop (barrier interrupted), clear, no power (the barrier's 24 V are missing) or off (door closed and no car in range). The ESP updates its address itself.
